title: Target Regeneration Shrinks the Gains of Draft-Training Objectives in Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29013v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models by verifying drafted tokens in parallel. New draft-training objectives are usually credited with the acceptance they add over cross-entropy on externally written responses, yet many pipelines let the target rewrite them. We ask how much of that gain survives. With a vision-language target and a block drafter, we train three objectives on four versions of one corpus: cross-entropy on corpus tokens, token-level distillation from the target, and distillation gated to positions that would survive verification. Distillation and the gate add large gains on external responses, but after greedy regeneration, distillation adds a smaller gain and the gate little or none. The shrinkage persists across data orders, position weights, verifiers, decoding temperatures and, for distillation, initializations and learning rates. translated_title: 目标重生成削弱了投机解码中草稿训练目标的收益
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过并行验证草稿令牌来加速大型语言模型的推理。新的草稿训练目标通常被认为是相比交叉熵在对外部撰写的回复上带来更高接受率的原因，然而许多训练流水线会让目标模型重写这些回复。我们探究了这些收益有多少能够保留下来。通过一个视觉-语言目标模型和一个块草稿器，我们在同一语料库的四个版本上训练了三种目标：语料令牌上的交叉熵、来自目标模型的令牌级蒸馏，以及仅在能通过验证的位置上启用的门控蒸馏。在外部回复上，蒸馏和门控都带来了显著收益，但在经过贪婪重生成后，蒸馏的收益变小，而门控几乎或完全没有收益。这种缩减在不同数据顺序、位置权重、验证器、解码温度下持续存在；对于蒸馏而言，在不同初始化和学习率下也是如此。在匹配监督长度以及每个目标的b……（原文截断）
tldr: 研究发现，投机解码中新的草稿训练目标（如令牌级蒸馏和验证门控蒸馏）在外部回复数据上的收益，在经过目标模型贪婪重生成后大幅缩水，且该现象在多种训练与解码设置下均稳定存在。
en_tdlr: The gains of new draft-training objectives in speculative decoding—such as token-level distillation and verification-gated distillation—shrink substantially after greedy target regeneration of external responses, and this shrinkage persists across diverse training and decoding settings.
